Bail Rejected for Mother-in-Law in Bhopal Daughter-in-Law Death Case

A Bhopal court has rejected the regular bail application of Giribala, the mother-in-law accused in the death of her daughter-in-law, Twisha Sharma. The court's decision was based on the ongoing investigation and the gravity of the case. Giribala had sought bail following Sharma's death, but the court found sufficient grounds to deny her request, keeping her in judicial custody. The case involves the death of Twisha Sharma under circumstances that led to her mother-in-law's arrest.
